content.short: Solend is a DeFi protocol on Solana that enables lending and borrowing.
content.description: Solend is a DeFi protocol that enables lending and borrowing on the Solana chain, letting users earn interest on deposits. Borrowers can take long or short positions on crypto assets, and the system maintains low transaction fees alongside high throughput to support rapid activity. The platform supports more than 40 pools and up to 16 different assets, providing diverse lending and borrowing options. It also features a governance token, SLND, which allows holders to participate in protocol governance and decision-making.
